products.name: Arcturus MK-II CQB Airsoft AEG
products.description: This airsoft gun is great for beginners because it has MOSFET, programmable trigger modes, a precision rotary hopup, and a 350rd mag. Don't worry about legal stuff, shipping airsoft guns to Oregon is legal.

products.name: Turbo Shells
products.description: Turbo shells that I can use for either breeding shell dwellers, decoration for my current tanks, calcium for my snails, or just shelf decoration (though I'd be surprised if I had empty shelf space for them).

products.name: JD001 Cyma M4 Gel Blaster
products.description: This is a gel blaster, so it shoots the soft little jelly balls. It shoots at about 230 FPS, so not as good as airsoft but still good enough to hit something. It comes with the gun, 3 mags, glasses, a battery and charger, and the owner's manual.

products.name: Korg Monotron Ribbon Synthesizer
products.description: This is a synthesizer. Like a music kind of synthesizer. I've wanted one of these for a long time. I don't know how to play one, but it looks like it would be kind of like a piano. They seem really fun and can make really cool music.

products.name: API Master Test Kit
products.description: This is a thing that all fish keepers must have. And I don't have one. I guess I'm not a fish keeper yet... It is for testing the water to make sure there are not too many nitrates and that there's no ammonia or nitrites, and that the pH is proper.

products.name: Cold Steel Tactical Katana Machete
products.description: This is manufactured by Cold Steel, a great brand trusted by many for weapons and stuff. They make lots and lots of weapons including spears, axes, knives, swords, and more. I will probably add more of their stuff to my wishlist.

products.name: Soldier Fly Larvae or Peas
products.description: Treats for the ducks. They will eat peas, pretty much any kind of bug larvae, and cooked oats. I said I wanted 1 but will take as many as you give me. They will eat just about as many treats as I give them.

products.name: Cold Steel Gladius Machete
products.description: This is made by Cold Steel, trusted by many for all sorts of weapons. It is a replica of a Roman sword used by foot soldiers.

products.name: Cold Steel Thai Machete
products.description: Cold Steel manufactures this beautiful machete modeled after Thai style swords. It is considered a hand-and-a-half sword because it is light enough for one hand but has a long enough handle you can use two hands if needed.

products.name: Cold Steel Throwing Knives
products.description: This is $9.99 for one throwing knife, also from Cold Steel. This knife has 5-star reviews and if you get 5-10 then it's 10% off meaning if you get 5 it would only be $44.96. If you got 10 it would be $89.91.

products.name: HUGE Seed Variety Pack
products.description: This says it has 30,000+ seeds. Yes, most of them are tiny ones like lettuce and okra, but still this is like 80% cheaper than buying individually from a store. And they are all types of plants that will grow pretty well here in Grants Pass.

products.name: Lancer Tactical Gen 2 M4 AEG
products.description: It is blue! And it comes with the gun, a mag, a battery, a charger, a bag of BBs, a couple patches, and a speed loader.

products.name: Traxxas Xmaxx with Batteries and Charger
products.description: This is something I have wanted for a very very long time: a HUGE rc car. This one is 1/5 scale I'm pretty sure. It is an absolute GIANT. Its huge. Like, BIG. And fast! It only goes about 40mph out of the box, but it can go up to 80+mph with aftermarket stuff. If purchasing PLEASE ENSURE YOU SELECT THE OPTION "Vehichle with Dual 4s Completer" OR PURCHASE COMPATIBLE BATTERIES AND A CHARGER!!! But even if you don't I will be super happy.

products.name: Traxxas Xmaxx Ultimate with Batteries and Charger
products.description: I have always wanted a huge rc car that goes super fast. This one is 30 inches long and goes about 40mph right out of the box. PLEASE ENSURE YOU SELECT THE OPTION "Vehichle with Dual 4s Completer" OR PURCHASE COMPATIBLE BATTERIES AND A CHARGER!!! But even if you don't I will be super happy.

products.name: Quail Eggs
products.description: This is kinda just a placeholder, I want quail but quail eggs is not the only thing I would need. I have included links for eggs and an enclosure, which is pretty much all I'd need.
